title: Machine learning screens 402,114 ionic liquids for CO2 absorption
summary: A synthesized trihexyl(tetradecyl)phosphonium perfluorooctanesulfonate showed higher CO2 solubility than the previous best ionic liquid in magnetic suspension balance measurement. Only one compound was confirmed.
ai_technology: ML model with wrapper feature selection
organization: Chuo University, Tokyo; Japan Science and Technology Agency (ACT-X)

evidence.unknown: Abstract only; single compound confirmed; full text not reviewed.
